item.title: 【環境】 Social inequalities mediate temperature–child maltreatment associations in Africa
item.description: Nature Climate Change, Published online: 15 May 2026; doi:10.1038/s41558-026-02650-9 The link between temperature and child maltreatment in Africa remains unexplored. This study demonstrates a substantial association, particularly among socio-economically disadvantaged families, driven by behavioural changes, occupational exposure and reduced household resources.

item.title: 【環境】 Enduring cultural legacies affect Euro-American wildlife values
item.description: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 15 May 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01825-8 Little is known about how values emerge, evolve and affect people’s relation with their natural environment. A study now sheds light on the influence of the institutions of European colonization on present-day values towards wildlife in the Americas.
